focus_areas: Wire-wrap integrity and physical plausibility at junctions
Internal texture consistency of amber segments
Shadow contact points with the background
custom_prompts_for_reflector: Pay close attention to the wire-wrapping details. In AI-generated jewelry, wires often float, fail to connect logically, or merge into the gems. Verify if the reflections on the amber pieces are consistent with a single light source. Note that this is a wire-wrapped necklace, not a chain-link necklace; do not penalize for missing chain links, but DO penalize for physically impossible wire structures.
image_description: A close-up photograph of an ornate, handcrafted necklace displayed on a black velvet-like surface. The necklace features large, irregular amber or resin segments with embedded floral or organic patterns, connected by gold-tone wire wrapping and small green beads. It forms a circular loop typical of a choker or short necklace style.
